risk.rationale: All suspicious signals for prof.kaya@aegean.edu have been investigated and explained away. The only CONFIRMED finding, F2 (Turkcell/TR sign-in, T1078.004), is a non-interactive mail-sync token (ExchangeSync/15), not a human sign-in — so it is not an account takeover chain. The impossible-travel claim is rejected (TR event is a service token; PT sign-ins use university VPN vpn-edge-02 from device LT-3104). The password-spray claim is rejected (193.140.10.21 is shared egress with 201 distinct MFA-completing accounts in 30 days; cross-account failures are background noise). Both VPN KEV claims are rejected (vpn-edge-02 firmware 22.7R2.8 includes the KEV fixes; vpn-edge-01 never carried a sign-in for this account). No data-quality conflicts exist. No confirmed takeover chain, no weak unexplained signal, and no conflicting/insufficient evidence requiring human review.
